entities.summary: Cintruénigo is a Spanish town and municipality located in the province and autonomous community of Navarre, northern Spain. Situated in the Merindad de Tudela in the Ribera de Navarra, in the comarca of Tudela in the lower reaches of the Alhama river and 92 km from the capital of the autonomous community, Pamplona. Its population in 2020 was of 8026 according to the Instituto Nacional de Estadistica.
